description:
Add 'Short Titles' to three Supreme Court cases in your library to ensure correct citation formatting. 

1. Locate 'Brown v. Board of Education' (1954) and set its Short Title to 'Brown'.
2. Locate 'Miranda v. Arizona' (1966) and set its Short Title to 'Miranda'.
3. Locate 'Obergefell v. Hodges' (2015) and set its Short Title to 'Obergefell'.

The Short Title field is located in the right-hand item detail pane (you may need to scroll down). Do not modify any other fields.
